pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rounded dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at the borders. Patches on the upper flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous interstitial network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes exhibit high connectivity, primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with slight narrowing in the lower posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette with low-to-medium amplitude serrations visible along the upper neck and shoulder line against the background.
